patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Drip and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Drip and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Drip only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce CRM/email platform with behavior-driven automation and contact-tier pricing from” rather than Mailjet's shape. Choose Mailjet only if your buying job matches “EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-volume pricin” rather than Drip's shape. Workflow advantage: Drip leans ecommerce-email; Mailjet leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Drip and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Drip is Ecommerce CRM/email platform with behavior-driven automation and contact-tier pricing from $39/mo.; Mailjet is EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-volume pricing (Sinch)..
- Company-size focus: Drip (small-business, mid-market) vs Mailjet (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Drip-leaning ecommerce-email vs Mailjet-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Drip — No forever-free plan — trial-only entry from $39/mo; Mailjet — Free plan daily send cap (200/day).

Limitations — Drip: No forever-free plan — trial-only entry from $39/mo; Contact-tier pricing rises as the store list grows; Mailjet: Free plan daily send cap (200/day); Automation depth concentrates on Premium+.

Poor-fit cases: Drip is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No forever-free plan — trial-only entry from $39/mo · Mailjet is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free plan daily send cap (200/day) · Avoid Drip if you actually need Mailjet's motion (EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-vol)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
